A bold abstract painting on a flat cream background: one big teal circle, one big pink triangle, one yellow zigzag stripe and one thick black wavy squiggle line, plus a few big black confetti dots. Retro eighties playful look: very few elements, big flat shapes, bold geometric accents.

Style: a bold, simple illustration that will be displayed TINY as a framed picture on an office wall in a pixel art game (smaller than 64 pixels wide). Use large flat areas of strong saturated color, high contrast between neighbouring shapes, chunky iconic shapes and very few details; no thin lines, no small text. The artwork must fill the ENTIRE wide canvas edge to edge (full bleed), with no white or empty margins and no letterboxing: no frame, no border, no wall, no mat, no signature, no letters.

A pixel art scene of a cheerful, empty retro eighties office interior in the afternoon, in top-down 3/4 view like a cozy management game. A light speckled terrazzo floor; two islands of teal desks with glowing teal monitors, keyboards and mugs, pink office chairs pushed in; a lounge corner with a curvy yellow sofa, pink and teal cushions and a round rug with black squiggles; potted cacti and palms in yellow and pink pots; tall shelves with colorful binders; a water cooler with a teal jug; a small coffee counter; a glass block partition. Big windows along the back wall show a bright sky with a few clouds. Cream walls decorated with big triangles, circles and zigzags. Bright, playful, inviting atmosphere, nobody there: no people, no characters, no animals. Keep it simple: big flat shapes, few details.

Style: authentic pixel art made of crisp hard-edged square pixels on a perfectly regular grid, limited palette, flat color fills with 3-4 shades per material, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no noise, no dithering. Playful, bright retro eighties office pixel art with its own original look: warm cream walls (#f4ecd8) with bold geometric patterns of triangles, circles, zigzags, black squiggles (#262626) and confetti dots, a light speckled terrazzo floor, teal (#2fb5a6) desks and sofas, bubblegum pink (#f07aa8) and sunny yellow (#f6c945) accents, lavender (#a593e0) and coral (#ef8354) details, glass block partitions, glowing teal monitor screens, potted cacti and palms. Original artwork: do not copy or imitate any existing game, tileset or artist. Outlines in dark blue-grey (#2b3245), never pure black. Light comes from the top-left. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
